_meta.source: IGN Registre Parcellaire Graphique, RPG.<year>:parcelles_graphiques for 2015-2024, via data.geopf.fr WFS 2.0.0
_meta.years_available_note: GetCapabilities advertises parcelles_graphiques for 2015-2024 only; 2010-2014 appear as an empty RPG.<year>:rpg_ stub. Code tables exist for 2022-2024 and only up to 2023 carry code_groupe.
_meta.area_basis: Declared hectares from each parcel's surf_parc property, the area the subsidy is paid on. Not re-derived from polygon geometry.
_meta.pulse_definition: RPG groups 8 (Proteagineux) and 15 (Legumineuses a grains), plus code SOJ which RPG files under group 7 (Autres oleagineux). Group membership read from the authoritative code table and verified present in both the 2015 and 2024 extracts.
_meta.why_not_project_crop_map: rpg_codes.CODE_CULTU_TO_CROP is built for the yield model: it sends MPC and PAG to other_legume and has no lupin key, so a pulse total taken from it understates by 136 ha in 2015 and 649 ha in 2024.
_meta.cell_assignment: Parcels assigned whole to the 5 km Lambert-93 cell containing their centroid; no clipping at cell edges. Cells under 50 declared ha get a null share rather than one computed on a handful of hectares.
_meta.no_parcel_matching: RPG id_parcel is not stable between campaigns, so no field-level before/after claim is made. Only each cell's crop mix is compared.

vocabulary_change_2023.evidence: Each code listed above is absent from RPG.2022:codes_cultures, present in RPG.2023:codes_cultures, and records zero hectares in this region for every campaign up to 2022. It could not be declared before 2023.
vocabulary_change_2023.consequence: Pulse area across the 2023 boundary is NOT comparable as published. The like-for-like figures are either 2015 to 2022, or the 2023 and 2024 totals with these codes removed - both are given in totals_by_year as *_like_for_like fields.
